Of Trump’s claims of progress in talks with Iran, Israeli analyst tells me “There are certain figures within the regime that apparently have laid a honey trap to try to get President Trump to go down this rabbit hole and listen…they're doing everything they can to try to fool the president.” @Dan_Diker @jerusalemcenter

A war with Iran was an obvious scenario for CENTCOM and Iran's ballistic missile and OWA UAS capabilities are well-known. The lack of underground command posts and hardened shelters—or even concrete barriers between tents, which were common at bases in Iraq and Afghanistan—at bases well within range of Iranian missiles and drones suggests a deeper problem about how the US military draws lessons. Swalwell: “I suspect it's politically motivated. Jim, I have the only lawsuit that has survived this presidency. It's me and the January 6th officers.”

Heads-up: Sec of State Rubio says Iran war may still have “weeks” to go:

“As the Department of War has consistently outlined, we are on or ahead of schedule in that operation and expect to conclude it at the appropriate time here, in a matter of weeks, not months.”

New: Oil prices today settled at their highest levels since the start of the US-Israeli war on Iran and the highest since July 2022.

Brent crude, the global benchmark, rose 4.22% to settle at $112.57 per barrel.
WTI, the US benchmark, rose 5.46%, to settle at $99.64 per barrel, after briefly hitting $100. -@CNN
